speaker: Doctor
text: The CBC results indicating low hemoglobin, low MCV, and a low reticulocyte count combined with your fatigue suggest a microcytic anemia; since you deny bleeding gums or bruising, have you experienced any abdominal pain, black tarry stools, or black coffee-ground emesis? speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia (APL).

The presence of blasts with Auer rods and severe thrombocytopenia confirms this diagnosis; I must request an immediate smear review and coagulation profile (PT/PTT) to assess for Disseminated Intravascular Coagulation. REQUEST TEST: Coagulation_Panel (PT, PTT, Fibrinogen, D-Dimer).
